scope: Guarded allocation and retry behavior for nested MLEADER CONTEXT_DATA collections in ASCII DXF parsing.

implementation.behavior: Each append checks the existing format item cap and uses DRW::reserve before publishing a new element or consuming its coordinate value. Failed reserves leave parser nesting and logical collection contents retryable.

control.allocationInjection: MaterialAllocationFailure offset 0 targets each collection reserve independently.
checks: Root allocation failure leaves CONTEXT_DATA open and permits LEADER retry and close.
Leader-line allocation failure leaves its parent root intact and permits line retry and close.
Point allocation failure leaves the point list empty and permits ordered XYZ retry and close.
Line-break and root-break allocation failures leave break lists empty and permit coordinate-component retry.

limits: This covers the listed nested MLEADER DXF allocation paths only.
It does not qualify MLEADER physical producer breadth, native annotation semantics, DWG parsing, or complete document conversion.
next: Continue P6 safety review at a separate reproduced parser allocation or rollback boundary; keep native and whole-document qualification gates open.
